name: Minato Shuugo
source: A third-year at Tsubakimachi High School and one of the members who lead their school to winning the End of Summer last year. Despite his tall stature and eye-hiding hairstyle, he is kind and cherishes his fellow clubmates very much. He is also the president of their Stride Club.
